caption:
Why your brand budget is an inherited guess.

A B2B brand budget percentage needs a rationale, not just last year’s number.

Build a one-page case: category position, objective, allocation logic and the leading indicator you will track. A new entrant and an established leader face different jobs. Use benchmarks as context, not a universal formula, and revisit the rationale when the competitive situation changes.

Read the source: https://www.rachitmishra.in/2026/07/30/b2b-brand-marketing-budget-percentage/

Send this to the finance partner reviewing your allocation rationale.
